title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Assessment: Justifying Parallel Line Angle Measures
description: Find missing angle measures and justify each answer with the correct angle relationship.

questions.question: If two parallel lines are cut by a transversal and $m\angle 3 = 64^\circ$, what is the measure of an angle corresponding to $\angle 3$?
questions.explanation: Corresponding angles are congruent, so the corresponding angle also measures 64°.

questions.question: $\angle 1$ and $\angle 2$ are same-side interior angles formed by parallel lines. If $m\angle 1 = 109^\circ$, what is $m\angle 2$?
questions.explanation: Same-side interior angles are supplementary, so $m\angle 2 = 180 - 109 = 71^\circ$.

questions.question: If two lines are parallel, alternate exterior angles are supplementary.
questions.explanation: Alternate exterior angles are congruent for parallel lines. Same-side interior angles are supplementary.

questions.question: An angle measuring $137^\circ$ forms a linear pair with angle $x$. The value of $x$ is ______.
questions.explanation: A linear pair is supplementary, so $x = 180 - 137 = 43$.

questions.question: Which justification best supports the statement $m\angle A = m\angle B$ when the angles are between parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal?
questions.explanation: Angles between the parallel lines on opposite sides of the transversal are alternate interior angles.

questions.question: Parallel lines are cut by a transversal. $m\angle 1 = 52^\circ$. $\angle 2$ corresponds to $\angle 1$, and $\angle 3$ forms a linear pair with $\angle 2$. Find $m\angle 3$ and justify the steps.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle 2 = 52^\circ$ because corresponding angles are congruent. Then $m\angle 3 = 128^\circ$ because a linear pair is supplementary.
questions.explanation: First copy the corresponding angle measure, then subtract from 180° for the linear pair.

questions.question: $m\angle 4 = 126^\circ$. $\angle 5$ is vertical to $\angle 4$. $\angle 6$ is same-side interior with $\angle 5$ on parallel lines. Find $m\angle 6$ and name both relationships.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle 5 = 126^\circ$ because vertical angles are congruent. $m\angle 6 = 54^\circ$ because same-side interior angles are supplementary.
questions.explanation: Vertical angles preserve the measure, and same-side interior angles on parallel lines add to 180°.

questions.question: Two alternate interior angles have measures $(3x + 8)^\circ$ and $83^\circ$ on parallel lines. The value of $x$ is ______.
questions.explanation: Alternate interior angles are congruent, so $3x + 8 = 83$. Then $3x = 75$ and $x = 25$.

questions.question: A student says, "The angle is alternate interior, so it must add to 180° with the given angle." Correct the student's reasoning.
questions.correctAnswer: Alternate interior angles are congruent when the lines are parallel. Same-side interior angles are the ones that are supplementary.
questions.explanation: This checks whether the relationship name and operation match: alternate interior means equal, not supplementary.

questions.question: Parallel lines are cut by a transversal. Angle A is $74^\circ$. Angle B is alternate exterior to A. Angle C forms a linear pair with B. Find $m\angle C$ and justify your answer.
questions.correctAnswer: $m\angle B = 74^\circ$ because alternate exterior angles are congruent. $m\angle C = 106^\circ$ because a linear pair is supplementary.
questions.explanation: Use the parallel-line theorem first, then the local linear-pair relationship at the intersection.
